_help:
Add an intent object to intents with a unique kebab-case id, enabled:true, match rules, and a reply.
Use exact for whole-message matches, phrases for contained phrases, or keywords for help-cued word matches.
Use replyNoSession when the user has not completed an analysis; when controls when the intent applies.
Intents provide text guidance only and never trigger UI actions.
Order is priority: the first matching intent wins, so put specific intents above general ones.
Set enabled:false to disable an intent without deleting it.
Available placeholders are {{maxFileSizeMB}}, {{maxDurationSec}}, and {{allowedFormats}}.
